settings.editor: Nestled amidst the towering peaks of the Karakoram, Hunza Valley is a breathtaking jewel of Pakistan, where time slows down and nature paints its most vibrant masterpiece. Imagine crystal-clear turquoise rivers winding through lush apricot orchards, snow-capped mountains like Rakaposhi and Ultar Sar piercing the sky, and ancient forts whispering tales of Silk Road legends. Hunza isn’t just a destination—it’s an enchanting escape into a world of serene beauty, rich culture, and warm hospitality. Trek through the surreal landscapes of Attabad Lake, stroll in the fairy-tale-like Hussaini Suspension Bridge, or witness the golden sunrise over Eagle’s Nest—every moment here feels like a dream. With its legendary longevity, delectable organic cuisine, and the soul-stirring grandeur of the Karakoram Highway, Hunza is more than a valley; it’s a symphony of nature, adventure, and tranquility. Come, let the magic of Hunza awaken your wanderlust! ✨🏔️

This 5-day family tour to Hunza is designed for comfort, fun, and unforgettable moments. From scenic mountain drives and historic forts to the peaceful beauty of Attabad Lake and lively local bazaars, each day offers something special for all ages. With smooth travel, cozy stays, and guided visits, this trip is the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation for your whole family.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_content:
• Breakfast at Balakot, followed by a visit to Dassu and Besham.
  • Tea & lunch break at Chilas.
  • Reach Gilgit by 5:00 pm for check-in.
  • Overnight stay in Gilgit.
  • If Naran is open, we will take the scenic Babusar Top road.

• Early morning breakfast.
  • Depart for Hunza (2 hours drive).
  • Arrive in Hunza around 1:30 pm.
  • Visit Rakaposhi View Point and explore the Altit & Baltit Forts.
  • Stroll through Karimabad Bazar and enjoy a meal at Cafe-De-Hunza.
  • An overnight stay in the heart of Hunza, Karimabad.

• Drive from Hunza to the China Border (approximately 3.5 hours one way).
  • Visit the beautiful Attabad Lake.
  • Explore the iconic Passu Cones and Hussaini Suspension Bridge.
  • Visit the Khunjerab Pass (China Border).
  • Return to Hunza and overnight stay in Karimabad.

• Early morning wake-up call for the Eagle’s Nest View Point to catch the breathtaking sunrise.
  • Depart for Besham (8-10 hours of travel).
  • Short scenic stops along the way.
  • Overnight stay in Chilas.
  • If Naran is open, we may stay in Naran

• Breakfast at Chilas or Naran.
  • Depart for Islamabad (5-6 hours travel).
  • Enjoy short stops along the way.
  • Drop-off at mentioned  locations in Islamabad.
